title: 配眼镜

lines.text: 王明的眼镜戴了五年，镜框都有点儿变形了，小雨陪他去眼镜店配一副新的。
lines.py: Wáng Míng de yǎn jìng dài le wǔ nián, jìng kuāng dōu yǒu diǎn r biàn xíng le, Xiǎo yǔ péi tā qù yǎn jìng diàn pèi yí fù xīn de.
lines.en: Wang Ming has worn his glasses for five years, and the frames have gone a bit out of shape, so Xiaoyu goes with him to the optician's to get a new pair.

lines.text: 王明愣了半天，自己也笑了：“看来，我五年前的眼光还不错。”
